prompt: A reusable transparent asset sheet for a gentle vampire-themed reading app belonging to the black-haired girl in the reference. Four separate ornaments in a clear two-by-two arrangement with generous transparent space: a small silver crescent brooch with a garnet and a wine-red bow; a horizontal wine-red ribbon with silver crescent clasp; a small charcoal folded cape-collar corner with silver edging; a dark-red wax seal embossed with a crescent. Hand-painted flat sticker art with slightly imperfect dark outlines, silver highlights and clean edges. Rich burgundy, charcoal, cool silver and pearl. Small decorative assets only, no panels, no lettering, no labels, no characters and no background.
